5261 hupogrammos {hoop-og-ram-mos'}

源自 259 的複合字 與 1125; TDNT - 1:772,128; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - example 1; 1

1) (字意) 寫字的範本, 包括字母表的所有字母, 作為給初學者學習描寫的輔助
2) 模範 (#彼前2:21|)
record.edic_text:
5261 hupogrammos {hoop-og-ram-mos'}

from a compound of 5259 and 1125; TDNT - 1:772,128; n m

AV - example 1; 1

1) a writing copy, including all the letters of the alphabet,
   given to beginners as an aid in learning to draw them
2) an example set before one
